content.text: WALKER: TEXAS RANGER — LONE STAR LEGACY (2026) Starring: Chuck Norris, Scott Eastwood Genre: Action • Neo-Western • Crime ThrillerTexas has changed. The border is a war zone, technology has replaced instinct, and the law has lost its edge. Cordell Walker has long since hung up his hat, living a quiet life in the hill country. But when a ghost from his past returns—a ruthless cartel boss he put away decades ago—and launches a coordinated attack on the Ranger headquarters, the state realizes it needs a hero who doesn't need a warrant to get justice.The legend returns to the line of fire. Walker (Chuck Norris), weathered but unbroken, is forced to unearth his badge and his fists. He pairs with a rebellious young Ranger (Scott Eastwood) who thinks he knows it all, bridging the generational divide with grit and firepower. Together, they dismantle the syndicate from the inside out, proving that while the world has moved on, the Walker way is timeless.The poster captures the stoic power of the living legend. Chuck Norris stands tall in the center, wearing a worn leather duster and his signature cowboy hat pulled low. His face is aged, bearded, and etched with intense focus. He stands against a backdrop of a stormy Texas sky and a burning cartel compound, his fists clenched and ready. The title "WALKER" is displayed in bold, metallic silver text with a Ranger star badge embedded in the background.
